annotator: independent Claude agent; saw only LABELING.md, annotator_view.md and occupation_list.csv

E01.note: SPM science leaver who will study up to a degree and likes caring: nursing, allied health technician and care roles up to job zone 4; no clear mistakes since nothing in her fields exceeds zone 5.

E02.note: Diploma electrical student, no further study: zone-3 electrical technician and maintenance roles; zone-5 engineering roles and teaching (disliked) are mistakes.

E03.note: CS graduate who codes in Python/JS/SQL: developer, data and security roles at zone 4; postsecondary teaching is people-facing, which he dislikes.

E04.note: Accounting graduate who likes rules and numbers: accounting, audit, tax, credit and compliance roles; artist-management work goes against her dislike of the arts.

E05.note: Art-and-design foundation, will study one level: design and visual roles up to zone 4; routine proofreading or data entry goes against his dislike of paperwork.

E06.note: TESL graduate who likes teaching children: school, ESL and tutoring roles at zone 4 or below; vocational/technical teaching clashes with her dislike of machines and manual work.

E07.note: SPM leaver who fixes vehicles and will take a TVET certificate: vehicle mechanic roles up to zone 3; parts/counter sales, dispatch and appraisal are desk or customer work he dislikes.

E08.note: Environmental science graduate with ArcGIS/R who may do a master's: environmental science, water, conservation and GIS roles up to zone 5; sales roles go against her stated dislike.

E09.note: LLB student planning to qualify for practice: lawyer, law clerk, mediation and compliance roles; judgeships need many years of practice and appointment, not a next move.

E10.note: Culinary diploma holder who wants a kitchen and later her own cafe: chef, cook, baker and food service manager roles; dietitian needs zone 5 and registration.

E11.note: Payroll clerk with a diploma, no more study: bookkeeping, HR admin, tax and office supervision at zone 3 or below; accountant needs the degree he refuses, quant is zone 5, desktop publishing is creative work he dislikes.

E12.note: Registered nurse who will not study further: specialist acute/critical care nursing, nurse manager, research nurse and health education; physician, nurse anaesthetist and nurse practitioner need licences or degrees beyond her plans.

E13.note: Call-centre agent with SPM who will take a certificate: office, clerical and service-sales roles up to zone 3; telemarketing is as unsteady as his current job and desktop publishing is creative work he dislikes.

E14.note: Graphic designer wanting to stay creative: art direction, UX/interface, product and motion design at zone 4; desktop publishing and prepress are routine production work leaving the creative side.

E15.note: CNC operator with SPM, no further study: CNC programming, machine setting, inspection and millwright roles at zone 2; engineer and production-manager roles need zone 4, and teaching goes against his dislike of helping roles.

E16.note: HR graduate working as an HR assistant: HR specialist, training, compensation and HR manager roles at zone 4; no clear mistakes near her fields.

E17.note: Maths teacher with no further study: training, adult education, tutoring and maths/data roles at zone 4; vocational/technical teaching clashes with his dislike of hands-on work.

E18.note: Paralegal with a law diploma, no degree planned: legal secretary, title/court clerk and regulatory clerical roles at zone 3; lawyer, law clerk, mediator and judge need a law degree and admission.

E19.note: Civil engineer wanting project or construction management: construction/project management, cost estimating and related civil specialties; architect needs a separate registration and teaching goes against his dislike of helping roles.

E20.note: Marketing executive aiming for management, analytics or brand: marketing/advertising/PR management, search marketing and BI analysis; window display is hands-on work she dislikes.

E21.note: IT diploma holder learning Python who will study one level: IT support, testing, web and junior developer roles up to zone 4; teaching CS is a helping role he dislikes.

E22.note: Finance graduate teller with Power BI/SQL: data, BI and financial analysis roles at zone 4; interface and game design are creative work she dislikes.

E23.note: Retiring police officer with a diploma: private investigation, security supervision and loss prevention at zone 3 or below; coroner needs legal or medical qualification he lacks.

E24.note: Flight attendant who trains crew and will study one level: training, HR and adult/vocational teaching up to zone 4; cabin-crew supervision keeps her flying, against her wish for a ground job.

E25.note: Assembly worker with SPM who will take a skills certificate: electrical/electronics technician and repair roles up to zone 3; zone-5 micro/nano engineering and engineering management are out of reach.

E26.note: Reporter wanting writing/communications work: PR, editing, technical and content writing at zone 4; AV, camera and broadcast technician roles are hands-on work he dislikes.

E27.note: Preschool teacher with a diploma who will study one level: child/family social work and human-service roles up to zone 4; psychologist roles need a master's and registration beyond her plans.

E28.note: Head chef leaving long kitchen hours: food science, quality control and food-safety roles up to zone 4; further cook or food-service management roles keep the hours he wants to escape.

E29.note: Lorry driver with SPM who must stop driving: dispatch, freight and logistics clerical roles at zone 2; logistician/manager roles need zone 4, and driving or manual loading is ruled out by his back.

E30.note: Pharmacist with a master's leaving retail: clinical research, regulatory affairs and medical science roles up to zone 5; pharmacy technician/aide are more counter work, and physician needs a medical licence.

E31.note: Chemistry graduate wanting lab work: chemical, QC, food and forensic lab roles at zone 4 or below; technical sales goes against her dislike of persuading and pharmacist needs a licence she cannot get.

E32.note: Networking diploma holder: IT support, network administration and telecom installer roles at zone 3; zone-5 research/maths roles are out of reach and design roles clash with his dislike of creative work.

E33.note: Mass-communication graduate running social media: PR, content, marketing and media production roles; proofreading is routine records work she dislikes.

E34.note: Retrenched production supervisor with a diploma: production planning, quality, industrial technician and operations supervision at zone 3; chief executive and engineering manager need zone 5.

E35.note: Business graduate who likes clients and targets: B2B and service sales, marketing, purchasing and business development roles at zone 4; no clear mistakes under the rules.

E36.note: SPM with a tailoring certificate: tailoring, sewing, upholstery and similar craft work at zone 2; interior, set, industrial and graphic design need zone 4 or 5.

E37.note: Mechanical engineering graduate with SolidWorks/MATLAB: mechanical, manufacturing and related engineering roles; teaching is a helping role he dislikes.

E38.note: SPM with a hospitality certificate, no more study: front desk, travel guide, restaurant and tourist-facing sales roles at zone 2; lodging manager, event planner and recreation worker need zone 4.

E39.note: Retrenched bank call-centre agent with a business diploma: banking clerical, collections and admin roles at zone 3 or below; quant analyst needs zone 5 and desktop publishing is creative work he dislikes.

E40.note: Psychology graduate willing to do a master's: counselling, social work, psychology and research roles up to zone 5; psychiatrist and psychiatric nurse need medical or nursing licences.
